extension_rules: New capabilities may add inspector content or tabs without moving the workstation shell.
New solver names may not replace GIZA NEXUS as the primary brand.
User-approved model-first navigation has three surface buttons; analysis and simulation remain in the inspector.
FINDINGS and solver panels must scroll inside the fixed inspector instead of changing dock geometry.
If a runtime screenshot cannot be captured, state that explicitly; never substitute a fabricated design freeze and label it runtime truth.
Central viewport content may switch between 3-D MODEL and internally scrollable MAP ATLAS without changing shell geometry.
ACTION GRAPH may add an internal atlas view and action layer but may not alter global navigation, inspector dock, or central viewport bounds.
VISIBILITY LAB may add a tenth internal atlas view and visibility layer but may not change central viewport bounds, global navigation, or inspector dock.
METRIC READINESS may add an internal atlas view but may not alter global shell geometry; readiness bars are workflow state only.
